analysis.session_summary: AUD led the board (+0.299%) and CHF lagged (-0.338%) in a quiet session where both US releases landed inside the noise floor. EUR chopped amid a French services miss that weakened it and a German services miss that produced an inverted bounce. BOJ December-hike headlines initially lifted JPY but the move fully retraced. The tape favors risk-friendly commodity FX, while the calendar ahead is empty.

themes.theme: Commodity FX leads without clear catalyst
themes.evidence: AUD strength 0.299% and NZD 0.178%; AUD/USD +21.7 pips, NZD/USD +10.6 pips.
CHF strength -0.338%; USD/CHF +26.8 pips, EUR/CHF +36.8 pips, AUD/CHF +36.7 pips.

themes.theme: US data sits in the noise
themes.evidence: Flash Manufacturing PMI 56.0 vs 55.4 and Revised UoM 48.0 vs 46.3 both muted; DXY -0.9 points.

themes.theme: European PMIs give conflicting EUR signals
themes.evidence: French Flash Services 48.4 vs 50.7 normal weakness, German Flash Services 51.7 vs 52.5 inverted strength.

currency_drivers.USD: US PMI and consumer sentiment both moved inside the noise floor, giving USD no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.EUR: French services miss weakened it, German PMI inverted and lifted it; net small rise.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own releases; initial +0.28% attempt fully retraced.
currency_drivers.GBP: Retail sales and services PMI both printed inside the noise floor; no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; strongest major, holding its range throughout.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; held range with no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; weakest major, sold from open to close.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; sold to -0.07%, recovered 92%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped within a 41.7-pip range and closed +7.9 pips, with French PMI and Lescure headline marking the extremes.

polarity_reads.read: Normal negative EUR reaction (0.093% weaker) shows market still selling EUR on eurozone downside surprises.
Inverted bounce (EUR stronger 0.048% despite miss) implies EUR short covering or bad-news fatigue.
Muted USD reaction inside noise floor gives no positioning signal.
Muted USD reaction inside noise floor despite beat gives no clear USD bid.

scenarios.name: Carry extension keeps AUD/NZD bid
scenarios.thesis: With US data muted and no AUD/NZD releases, the risk-friendly tone extends; AUD and NZD continue to be bought, CHF remains offered.
triggers: Lack of negative headline for commodity FX
scenarios.invalidation: A BOJ repricing or US calendar shock draws flows back into USD/JPY.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD strongest at 0.299%; targeting measured 34.8-pip range.
NZD selling rejected; targeting measured 24.0-pip range.
CHF weakest at -0.338%; targeting measured 41.9-pip range.

scenarios.name: Range reversion after stretched moves
scenarios.thesis: No fresh catalyst leaves Monday Asia to fade the strongest and weakest pairs; AUD/CHF and EUR/CHF revert.
scenarios.invalidation: A strong BOJ December hike headline extends the AUD/JPY and NZD/JPY carry trade.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/NZD +15.6 pips stretched; move measured in input.
EUR/CHF +36.8 pips stretched; targeting measured move.
AUD/CHF +36.7 pips stretched; targeting measured move.

scenarios.name: BOJ repricing lifts JPY
scenarios.thesis: BOJ December rate-hike headline resurfaced and JPY attempt rejected; renewed focus on policy divergence forces USD/JPY and CHF/JPY lower.
triggers: BOJ expected to continue rapid rate hikes, focusing on December
scenarios.invalidation: US yields or risk appetite keep carry demand active.

CHF/JPY range 115.0 pips, JPY strength potential.

risks.why_it_matters: JPY attempt led +0.28% then gave back 100%, leaving a hawkish trigger in the tape.
It was high impact and moved commodity FX and CAD.
With no scheduled events, flow and headline risk dominate.
risks.watch: US cash open and global risk sentiment.
